package: GitHub Release assets on the tag: one self-contained `ch` binary (CLI + MCP server) per platform, 7 platforms plus checksums.txt, each binary carrying SLSA build provenance (`gh attestation verify`) and published only after two independent builds of the same commit proved byte-identical.

config.note: cork-defaults.json is a versioned surface of this component. Installs runtime-fetch it from the main branch (TTL-cached) as the living-field channel; the content at this tag is pinned here by digest.

notices: Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.

This version pins the market-registry 0.3.3 and phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 addresses on both chains; the quickstart names market-registry 0.3.3 throughout (the 0.1.0-rc.3 quickstart's 0.3.2 misstatement is fixed at this tag).

Venue premium migration: this version reads and writes `premium_annualized` on the order-book surface; the legacy percent `premium` field it replaces is removed from cork-api on 2026-08-17 (documented in the CHANGELOG with the removal date).
Distribution channel: the pinned integration channel is the GitHub Release binaries above. The OCI/apk package channels are not yet part of any pin.
